pr_title: driver: uart_npcx: Fix uart to use PM constrain
pr_body:
The device PM callback needs to be used only to suspend/resume devices.
If the system cannot be suspended because UART is in a particular
state, the pm_constraint_set/release API should be used. For NPCX UART,
the chip can't enter low power idle state until UART completes the data
transmission.
This commit changes NPCX UART to use pm_constraint_set/release & fixes
UART lost data from low power idle.

Fix #40621

issue_context.title: npcx uart driver uses device PM callback to block suspension
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

The npcx UART driver is currently using the device PM callback to block suspension if the UART is transmitting, as shown below:

https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/5e035b0f4eb43df68313b401e0a71d2cdcd54d65/drivers/serial/uart_npcx.c#L441-L460

The device PM callback needs to be used only to suspend/resume devices. If the system cannot be suspended because UART is in a particular state, the `pm_constraint_set/release` API should be used.

**To Reproduce**

https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/drivers/serial/uart_npcx.c

**Expected behavior**

Device driver should prevent system suspension by using `pm_constraint_set/release` API.

**Impact**

PM API misuse, PM subsystem needs to account for such “special cases” when it should not.

**Logs and console output**

N/A

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Linux
 - Toolchain: Zephyr SDK
 - Commit SHA or Version used: 5e035b0

**Additional context**

STM32 UART driver may be taken as an example: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/drivers/serial/uart_stm32.c#L85
comments: @gmarull Got it. Nuvoton will prepare a PR to fix this bug.

review_comments: note: the PM constraint API uses ref counting, are you sure you need atomics here? If you call `pm_constraint_set` N times, the constraint won't be released after N other calls to `pm_constraint_release`.

We use the constrain for UART transmission. pm_constraint_set() may be invoked when any UART transmission request. However, we couldn't know how much time invoking pm_constraint_set() if we didn't maintain a local counter when the complete transmission ISR. The pm_constraint_set() may be invoked several times before the complete ISR. So we use this to guarantee the set/release is compared.
